notes: National rules; the Bundesland (region) doesn't change these deadlines. Tax return dates assume a calendar financial year.

items.name: Annual Financial Statements — Preparation and Publication (Jahresabschluss)
items.rule: Published via the Unternehmensregister within 12 months after financial year end (4 months for capital-market companies)
items.description: Prepared under the HGB within 3 months (6 months for small companies) and published; the Federal Office of Justice fines late publication.

items.name: Shareholders' Approval of the Annual Accounts
items.rule: Within 8 months after financial year end (11 months for small GmbH)
items.description: Shareholders adopt the annual accounts and decide on the use of profit (GmbHG §42a).

items.name: Annual General Meeting (Hauptversammlung)
items.rule: Within the first 8 months of the financial year
items.description: The AGM receives the adopted accounts and resolves on the appropriation of profit and discharge of the boards (AktG §175).

items.name: Corporate Income Tax and Trade Tax Returns (KSt / GewSt)
items.rule: 31 July of the following year (extended to the end of February of the second following year when a tax adviser files)
items.description: Filed electronically via ELSTER with the e-balance sheet (E-Bilanz); trade tax is assessed by the municipality.

items.name: Corporate Income Tax and Trade Tax Prepayments
items.rule: Corporate income tax: 10 March, 10 June, 10 September, 10 December; trade tax: 15 February, 15 May, 15 August, 15 November
items.description: Quarterly advance payments set by the tax office and municipality based on the last assessment.

items.name: Annual VAT Return (Umsatzsteuerjahreserklärung)
items.rule: 31 July of the following year (later when a tax adviser files)
items.applies: VAT-registered businesses (not small businesses under §19 UStG)

items.name: VAT Advance Return (Umsatzsteuer-Voranmeldung, monthly)
items.rule: 10th of the following month (one month later with a permanent extension)
items.applies: Businesses with prior-year VAT over €9,000, and new businesses in their first two years
items.description: Filed via ELSTER with payment by the same date.

items.name: VAT Advance Return (Umsatzsteuer-Voranmeldung, quarterly)
items.applies: Businesses with prior-year VAT between €2,000 and €9,000
items.description: Filed via ELSTER with payment by the same date.

items.name: Transparency Register (Transparenzregister)
items.rule: On formation and without delay after any change in beneficial ownership
items.description: Beneficial owners must be reported to the Transparency Register under the Money Laundering Act (GwG).

items.name: Payroll Tax Return (Lohnsteuer-Anmeldung)
items.rule: 10th of the following month (quarterly or annually for small payrolls)
items.description: Wage tax, solidarity surcharge and church tax withheld are declared and paid to the tax office.

items.name: Social Security Contributions (Sozialversicherungsbeiträge)
items.rule: Third-to-last banking day of each month (contribution statement two banking days earlier)
items.description: Employer and employee contributions for pension, health, long-term care and unemployment insurance are paid to the employees' health insurance funds.

items.name: Annual Payroll Tax Certificates (Lohnsteuerbescheinigung)
items.rule: End of February (for the previous calendar year)

items.name: Accident Insurance Wage Statement (Berufsgenossenschaft)
items.description: The digital wage statement to the employer's liability insurance association.

items.name: Transfer Pricing Documentation
items.rule: Provided within 30 days of a tax audit request (extraordinary transactions documented within 6 months of year end)
items.description: Master file and local file requirements depend on group size and transaction volumes (§90(3) AO).
